say:1:1430243201:1.text: Look at the statue in front of you. It was built when the Queen founded Sal'thorin.
say:1:1430243201:1.source_cn: 看看你眼前的雕像，它在女王建立萨洛克兰时被建起。
say:1:1430243201:1.male: Look at the statue in front of you. It was built when the Queen founded Sal'thorin.
say:1:1430243201:1.female: Look at the statue in front of you. It was built when the Queen founded Sal'thorin.

say:2:1430243202:1.text: Her Majesty has maintained this statue with her immense power for uncountable years.
say:2:1430243202:1.source_cn: 女王用她的法力维系着她的雕像，已经不知道过了多久。
say:2:1430243202:1.male: Her Majesty has maintained this statue with her immense power for uncountable years.
say:2:1430243202:1.female: Her Majesty has maintained this statue with her immense power for uncountable years.

say:3:1430243203:1.text: The statue, like Her Majesty herself, will stand in Sal'thorin until the end of days.
say:3:1430243203:1.source_cn: 这座雕像就像女王本人一样，永远的立于萨洛克兰。
say:3:1430243203:1.male: The statue, like Her Majesty herself, will stand in Sal'thorin until the end of days.
say:3:1430243203:1.female: The statue, like Her Majesty herself, will stand in Sal'thorin until the end of days.
